---
title: MEZO Gauges Overview
description: >-
  veMEZO holders direct MEZO emissions to MUSD liquidity pools on Curve,
  Uniswap, and Aerodrome
topic: users
---

import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

**MEZO Gauges let veMEZO holders vote to direct MEZO emissions to liquidity pools outside Mezo**, on Curve and Uniswap (Ethereum) and Aerodrome (Base).

Until now, veMEZO had one job: [boosting](/docs/users/mezo-earn/lock/vemezo/boost-mechanism) a veBTC position. Now, veMEZO carries voting power of its own, over a real slice of weekly emissions.

---

## Why pay LPs on other chains?

MUSD is only useful if it is liquid where people already are. Thin pools off Mezo mean MUSD cannot be entered or exited at size, and that caps how large the MUSD debt book can safely grow.

---

## How MEZO Gauges differ from other gauges

Mezo operates three kinds of gauges:
| | Staking gauge | veBTC boost gauge | **MEZO Gauge** |
|---|---|---|---|
| You vote with | veBTC | veMEZO | **veMEZO** |
| Emissions land | On Mezo chain, to stakers | N/A | **Off Mezo chain, as pool incentives** |
| Voter earns | Trading fees + incentives | Posted incentives | **Incentives posted on the gauge** |

:::note
MEZO Gauges are **non-staking gauges**: there is no LP token to stake on Mezo, because the liquidity being incentivised lives on another chain. Voting on them is entirely independent of your veBTC voting and of boost matching. Directing veMEZO to a MEZO Gauge does not consume or reduce any boost you are providing. The mechanism can support non-staking gauges that stay on Mezo in future.
:::

---

## Which pools are eligible

Four gauges are live at launch:

| Gauge | Pool | Venue | Chain | Distribution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Uniswap USDC/MUSD | USDC/MUSD | Uniswap | Ethereum | Merkl |
| Curve USDT/USDC/MUSD | USDT/USDC/MUSD | Curve | Ethereum | Merkl |
| Aerodrome USDC/MUSD | USDC/MUSD | Aerodrome | Base | Aerodrome voting incentives |
| Aerodrome MEZO/MUSD | MEZO/MUSD | Aerodrome | Base | Aerodrome voting incentives |

### How the list changes

The set of eligible pools is an on-chain allowlist held by the remote gauge registry and controlled by governance. Pools are added or removed by governance action, not by anyone permissionlessly creating a gauge. When the list changes, it changes here and on the Vote page.

---

## How much MEZO is directable

MEZO Gauges are funded from the **non-staking gauge branch** of emissions, currently **8% of weekly emission rewards**. veBTC holders set that share through the [splitter](/docs/users/mezo-earn/overview/glossary#splitter). See [Emissions Schedule](/docs/users/mezo/emissions) for more info.

---

## The loop, end to end

<Steps>
1. **You vote.** Direct veMEZO voting power across the available MEZO Gauges during the epoch.
2. **The epoch closes** Thursday 00:00 UTC and votes are tallied. Each gauge's share of MEZO is set by its share of veMEZO votes.
3. **MEZO leaves Mezo.** Each gauge's allocation is claimed and routed to its destination.
4. **It lands as an incentive** on the destination pool for LPers to claim on Merkl or voters on Aerodrome.
</Steps>

The exact timing and form differ by venue. See [Where Your Vote Goes](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/where-your-vote-goes).

---

## What a voter earns

You earn a share of the incentives posted on the gauge you vote for, sized by your share of that gauge's veMEZO votes. [Boost gauge](/docs/users/mezo-earn/lock/vemezo/matching-market) incentives work the same way. Anyone can post incentives on a MEZO Gauge, and voters can claim them.

The MEZO itself travels on. It lands on the destination pool and pays that pool's LPs or voters, according to the protocol. Your vote decides where MUSD liquidity gets paid for. The incentives sitting on the gauge are what pay you.

To collect the directed MEZO too, work both sides: LP into the destination pool, and on Aerodrome, vote for the matching gauge on Base. [Where Your Vote Goes](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/where-your-vote-goes#capturing-the-value-you-direct) walks through that loop.

---

## Next steps

- [How to Vote on MEZO Gauges](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/how-to-vote) — the walkthrough
- [Where Your Vote Goes](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/where-your-vote-goes) — how weight becomes incentives, and when
- [Claiming Incentives](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/claiming-incentives) — for LPs in the destination pools
- [How to Lock MEZO](/docs/users/mezo-earn/lock/vemezo/how-to-lock-mezo) — if you don't hold veMEZO yet

---
title: How to Vote on MEZO Gauges
description: Step-by-step guide to directing veMEZO voting power to MEZO Gauges
topic: users
---

import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

MEZO Gauges are voted on with **veMEZO**, on their own page, independently of veBTC gauge voting and boost matching.

## Prerequisites

- A [wallet connected to Mezo](/docs/users/getting-started/connect)
- An active veMEZO position
- A small amount of BTC for gas

You do **not** need veBTC, an LP position, or a position in the destination pool to vote. See [How to Lock MEZO](/docs/users/mezo-earn/lock/vemezo/how-to-lock-mezo) if you don't have veMEZO yet.

---

## Cast your vote

<Steps>
1. Go to the **Vote** tab on [mezo.org](https://mezo.org) and switch to **veMEZO** voting — the veMEZO gauge list at [mezo.org/earn/vote/mezo](https://mezo.org/earn/vote/mezo).

2. Review the available gauges. Each row lists the destination protocol and chain, the pool, any incentives posted on the gauge, and the date this epoch's emissions reach that pool.

3. Enter the percentage of your veMEZO voting power you want to allocate to each gauge. You can split across several, for example 60% to Aerodrome USDC/MUSD and 40% to Curve USDT/USDC/MUSD.

4. Click **Submit Votes** and sign the transaction.
</Steps>

Your allocation is registered for the current epoch as soon as the transaction confirms.

{/* Save the voting UI capture as public/docs/images/mainnet/mezo-gauges-vote.png, then uncomment: */}
{/* ![The veMEZO gauge list on mezo.org](/docs/images/mainnet/mezo-gauges-vote.png) */}

:::note[Reading the table]
Each row shows the destination **Protocol** (its logo plus a chain sigil, linking out to the venue), the **Gauge**, the **Incentives** posted on it, and the **Distribution date** — when this epoch's emissions reach the destination pool, in UTC.

There is no vAPR, fees, or TVL, because those accrue on Curve, Uniswap, or Aerodrome rather than on Mezo. Incentives are posted on the MEZO Gauge itself and paid to veMEZO voters.
:::

---

## The voting window

MEZO Gauges follow the same weekly cycle as the rest of Mezo Earn.

- Epochs run **7 days, turning over Thursday 00:00 UTC**
- Voting is open throughout the epoch and closes at the turnover
- Votes are tallied at the turnover, and each gauge's MEZO allocation is set by its share of total veMEZO votes cast on MEZO Gauges

**Unvoted emissions.** MEZO is split across MEZO Gauges strictly in proportion to the votes cast. A gauge that receives no votes receives no MEZO, and its share is spread across the gauges that did get votes. Voting power you leave unallocated simply does not influence the split, and earns you no incentives.

---

## Changing or resetting your vote

Your allocation **persists across epochs** until you change it. If you are happy with your split, you do not need to re-submit every week — it keeps earning you a share of that gauge's incentives each epoch.

**To change it:** return to the MEZO Gauges page, enter a new allocation, and submit. The new split replaces the old one from the epoch in which it confirms.

**To reset it:** set your allocation to zero across all gauges and submit, which withdraws your voting power from MEZO Gauges entirely.

You can change or reset as often as you like within an epoch; only your allocation at the epoch turnover counts toward that epoch's split.

:::caution
Changing your vote mid-epoch moves your **whole** weight for that epoch. You are not credited pro-rata for the part of the week your earlier allocation was in place.
:::

---

## Does this affect my boost or my veBTC votes?

No. Voting on MEZO Gauges is independent:

- It does not consume veMEZO you are using to [boost](/docs/users/mezo-earn/lock/vemezo/boost-mechanism) a veBTC position, and does not reduce a boost you have already provided
- It does not require a [poke](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/how-to-vote#important-poke-after-changes) — poking refreshes veBTC boosted weight, which MEZO Gauge voting does not touch
- It has no effect on where your veBTC votes send staking gauge emissions

---

## Next steps

- [Where Your Vote Goes](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/where-your-vote-goes) — what happens after the epoch closes
- [Claiming Incentives](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/claiming-incentives) — how LPs collect the MEZO you directed
- [MEZO Gauges Overview](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges) — the mechanism and the eligible pools

---
title: Where Your Vote Goes
description: >-
  How veMEZO voting weight becomes incentives on Curve, Uniswap, and Aerodrome
  pools
topic: users
---

import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Each MEZO Gauge receives a share of the non-staking gauge emissions equal to its share of the veMEZO votes cast on MEZO Gauges that epoch.

If 1,000,000 veMEZO votes across all MEZO Gauges and 300,000 of them go to one gauge, that gauge takes 30% of the epoch's directable MEZO. The rest of this page uses USDC/MUSD as an example. The same split applies to every MEZO Gauge.

---

## Curve and Uniswap via Merkl

Curve USDT/USDC/MUSD and Uniswap USDC/MUSD are incentivised through [Merkl](https://merkl.xyz), the same mechanism Mezo already uses for these pools, now each with a MEZO Gauge.

<Steps>
1. **Epoch N closes.** Votes are tallied and each gauge's MEZO allocation is fixed.
2. **The allocation is posted to Merkl** as a campaign on the destination pool.
3. **LPs accrue a claim** proportional to their share of the pool over the campaign period. Claims occur on Merkl.
</Steps>

**Rewards arrive as veMEZO locked for 3 months**, not as liquid MEZO. This matches how these pools are incentivised today, but now voters decide how much emissions each pool gets.

See [Claiming Incentives](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/claiming-incentives) for the LP-side walkthrough.

---

## MEZO as voting incentives on Aerodrome

Aerodrome gauges work differently, because Aerodrome is itself a ve(3,3) system with its own weekly vote. Take USDC/MUSD as an example. MEZO does not go to Aerodrome LPs directly. It is deposited as a **voting incentive** on the Aerodrome gauge for that pool, paid to the veAERO holders who vote for it.

Those veAERO votes are what direct **AERO emissions** to the pool. The MEZO buys AERO emissions for the pool, and it is the AERO that reaches LPs. The same path applies to MEZO/MUSD on Aerodrome.

Mechanically, the MEZO is claimed on Mezo, bridged to Base, and deposited on the Aerodrome gauge by an allocator contract. This runs automatically each epoch.

### The two-epoch lag

Aerodrome's vote is a week ahead of the incentive it responds to, which puts a gap between your vote and the liquidity it buys:

| Epoch | What happens |
|---|---|
| **N** | You vote on Mezo. Epoch closes and the allocation is fixed. |
| **N+1** | MEZO is deposited as a voting incentive on the Aerodrome gauge. veAERO holders vote on it during this epoch. |
| **N+2** | AERO emissions flow to the pool, and LPs earn them. |

**Votes cast in epoch N produce AERO emissions in epoch N+2.** This is a property of how Aerodrome sequences its own epochs as opposed to a delay Mezo adds.

---

## Capturing the value you direct

Directing emissions is influence, not yield. The MEZO you send to a destination pool goes to the people on that pool — Merkl claimants on Curve and Uniswap, veAERO voters on Aerodrome. It does not come back to you as a MEZO Gauge voter.

What you earn directly as a voter is your share of **incentives posted on the MEZO Gauge itself**, in proportion to your share of that gauge's votes.

To capture the emissions themselves, you have to be on both sides of the loop. On Aerodrome, using USDC/MUSD as an example:

<Steps>
1. **LP** into the pool on Aerodrome and stake in its gauge.
2. **Vote** for that pool's MEZO Gauge on Mezo, with veMEZO.
3. **Vote** for the corresponding Aerodrome gauge on Base, with veAERO.
4. **Collect** AERO for the LP position, and the MEZO voting incentive for the veAERO vote.
</Steps>

On Curve and Uniswap the loop is shorter: LP into the pool, vote for its MEZO Gauge, and claim the campaign on Merkl as an LP.

:::note
Running the full loop is optional. Plenty of veMEZO holders will vote purely to strengthen MUSD liquidity and to earn incentives posted on the gauge.
:::

---

## Next steps

- [Claiming Incentives](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/claiming-incentives) — claim on Merkl or Aerodrome
- [How to Vote on MEZO Gauges](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/how-to-vote) — the walkthrough
- [MEZO Gauges Overview](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges) — eligible pools and funding

---
title: Claiming Incentives
description: How LPs and voters claim the MEZO directed by MEZO Gauges
topic: users
---

import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Who claims what, and where, depends on which side of the gauge you are on.

| You are | You claim | Where |
|---|---|---|
| An LP in Curve USDT/USDC/MUSD or Uniswap USDC/MUSD | veMEZO locked for 3 months | [Merkl](https://app.merkl.xyz) |
| A veAERO holder voting for Aerodrome USDC/MUSD or MEZO/MUSD | MEZO, as a voting incentive | [Aerodrome](https://aerodrome.finance) |
| An LP in Aerodrome USDC/MUSD or MEZO/MUSD | AERO emissions | [Aerodrome](https://aerodrome.finance) |
| A veMEZO holder who voted on a MEZO Gauge | Incentives posted on that gauge | The Vote tab on [mezo.org](https://mezo.org) |

---

## Curve and Uniswap LPs: Claim on Merkl

Rewards are **not** pushed to your wallet. Merkl accrues a claim against your address, and you have to collect it.

<Steps>
1. Go to [app.merkl.xyz](https://app.merkl.xyz).
2. Connect the wallet holding the LP position.
3. Open **Dashboard**. It lists every reward that wallet can claim, so you do not need to find the campaign yourself.
4. Click **Claim** and sign the transaction.
</Steps>

**What you receive:** veMEZO locked for 3 months, not liquid MEZO. Once claimed, it behaves like any other [veMEZO position](/docs/users/mezo-earn/lock/vemezo). It can boost a veBTC position, and it can vote on MEZO Gauges.

If you LP in the pool, you can vote that veMEZO back onto the pool's MEZO Gauge to direct more emissions there. That is optional. Providing liquidity during the campaign is enough to claim.

:::caution[Unclaimed rewards are forfeited]
Merkl campaigns do not accrue indefinitely. If you never claim, you lose the rewards. If you LP in these pools, check Merkl periodically.
:::

You do not need to hold veMEZO, or have voted, to claim as an LP. Providing liquidity to the pool during the campaign is the only requirement.

---

## Aerodrome: Claim on Base

MEZO directed to an Aerodrome gauge is deposited as a **voting incentive**, so it is claimed by veAERO voters, not by LPs.

**If you hold veAERO and voted for USDC/MUSD or MEZO/MUSD:** go to [aerodrome.finance](https://aerodrome.finance), open your veAERO lock, and claim your rewards for the epoch. Your MEZO share is proportional to your share of the votes on that gauge.

**If you LP in Aerodrome USDC/MUSD or MEZO/MUSD:** stake your position in the pool's gauge and claim **AERO** emissions there. Note the [two-epoch lag](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/mezo-gauges/where-your-vote-goes#the-two-epoch-lag) between a Mezo vote and the AERO it produces.

---

## MEZO Gauge voters: Claim on Mezo

If you directed veMEZO to a MEZO Gauge, you earn a share of any **incentives posted on that gauge**, proportional to your share of its votes.

Claim these the same way as any other voting reward — on the **Vote** tab at [mezo.org](https://mezo.org), once the epoch has closed. See [Claiming Fees & Emissions](/docs/users/mezo-earn/vote/claiming-fees-emissions).

These incentives are separate from the emissions you directed. The emissions go to the destination pool; the incentives are posted on Mezo to attract your vote there in the first place.

---
